profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Geraldo López Rosa earned a Computer Engineering degree from the University of Puerto Rico Mayagüez.

Regarded as an open-minded leader with a proactive approach to tackling tasks. Proficient in problem-solving and adept at analyzing complex issues. Demonstrated capability in executing end-to-end projects, encompassing design, coding, testing, and integration, based on previous experiences.

positions.title: Chief Networking Officer
positions.locationName: Univerity of Puerto Rico @ Mayaguez Campus
positions.description:
Managed a team of 5 students who act as intermediate between companies and our members, developing relationships with company recruiters and helping out companies during the Job Jair weeks.

Approached new companies to sponsor our association to collaborate with and organized new activities to help the development of our members.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Built, procured and supported automated tool sets that enable AGILE engineering adoption.

Developed tools versioned with GIT, building using Jenkins, writing in Python, JavaScript, Java, hosted on Tomcat, Apache, using Docker, deployed using Jenkins and uDeploy, and wrote test scripts to be included as part of an automated pipeline.

volunteerExperiences.description: Visited Zambia to help build houses for orphaned children.

organizations.name: National Society of Professional Engineers (NSPE)
organizations.position: Corporate Development Program Mentor · Aug 2016 - Present
